answer: Each plucker's basket carries his own mark burned into the rim, and the shed register holds the mark of every plucker on the estate. A fable basket marked with a copied brand fails the register: the burn must match the shed's own iron at the lantern of the rim, and a copied brand is shallow and wrong. Forging a mark means bribing the shed keeper, faking a season of entries and paying 9,300, and the zenith entry in the register is read at every wage day, so a basket whose mark was never entered is emptied and taken away.
